name: an-unmeasured-ffmpeg-major-is-refused
breaks: the check accepts any ffmpeg that will say what version it is, so the list of majors there is a drift reading for stops being consulted at all. MEASURED_FFMPEG_MAJORS became a list rather than one value in #1226, because the runner went to ffmpeg 9 while Dan's Mac stayed on 8, and widening a guard is how one stops guarding: this is what holds the list to being a record of evidence rather than a place versions get added to make a run go green
